The proof begins with a simple observation about the shape of the curve, which the author states without ceremony and then spends three pages defending against every obvious objection.

What follows is the usual machinery, assembled with care, and the reader who has followed this far will recognise each step before it is taken, though perhaps not the order in which they are arranged.

The result, when it arrives, is smaller than the build-up suggests, and the author says as much, which is part of why the paper is still read.
